# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Rendering and platform compatibility**

## Highlights

Upcoming changes improve callback ABI correctness, Android frame pacing, and Uno Platform 7 compatibility. They also correct Unicode validation, Linux HarfBuzz symbol conflicts, and WebGPU application linking. Review Apple minimums, Uno control behavior, and SKData length validation before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **Apple native deployment baselines raised** — Native SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp now require macOS 11 or iOS/tvOS/Mac Catalyst 14. Managed iOS/tvOS minimums rise to 14; managed macOS 12 and Mac Catalyst 15 requirements remain higher. Raise application deployment targets as needed without lowering existing managed or framework requirements. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383))
- **Uno views require Uno Platform 7** — The non-Windows Uno views assembly now requires .NET 10 and Uno 7; pre-Uno 7 WasmShell pipelines are no longer supported. SKSwapChainPanel becomes a Grid-based CPU fallback with null GRContext and drops RaiseOnUnsupported. Use SKCanvasElement for Uno GPU rendering. The Windows facade retains its ANGLE-backed control. ([#5377](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5377))
- **SKData copy lengths are checked** — SKData.CreateCopy(byte[], ulong) throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException when the requested length exceeds the array. Pass a length within the source array instead of relying on an out-of-bounds native read. ([#5429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5429))
- **WebGPU links require updated native archives** — The emdawnwebgpu C++ support now ships inside libSkiaSharp.a rather than compiling on the application link line. Use matching rebuilt Graphite-enabled archives; older or GPU-disabled custom archives do not satisfy the new contract. The .NET 8 built-in WebGPU path is retained. ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native callback boolean widths corrected** — Skia callbacks use one-byte native bool values and HarfBuzz callbacks use four-byte hb_bool_t values. Public managed delegates remain bool; false-returning glyph-name callbacks no longer copy an invalid name. ([#5479](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5479))
- **Unicode character-code validation corrected** — GetUnicodeCharacterCode validates a single encoded unit and decodes its byte width correctly: ASCII for UTF-8, BMP for UTF-16, and a Unicode scalar for UTF-32. GetString now reports ArgumentNullException for null byte arrays. ([#5506](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5506))
- **Linux HarfBuzz calls stay within the bundled library** — Prevents ELF symbol preemption from mixing bundled and system HarfBuzz objects when GTK loads system HarfBuzz first, without changing exported hb_* entry points. — ❤️ [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing) ([#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352))
- **Android continuous texture rendering follows display refresh** — Uses Choreographer pulses for automatic frames while keeping GL work on its worker thread. Explicit render requests and synchronous lifecycle progress remain independent; this does not promise presentation timing. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **WebGPU application links no longer compile the C++ port** — Moves port compilation into libSkiaSharp.a so application C sources are not passed incompatible C++ flags. JavaScript glue remains a link input rather than deployed application content. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))
- **SkSL validation corrected** — Rejects shader slot-count overflow and invalid runtime-effect types earlier. ([#5489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5489))
- **GLES upload format corrected** — Ganesh GL no longer advertises unsupported BGRA8-as-RGBx uploads in GLES; readback is unchanged. ([#5500](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5500))
- **C-string buffer over-read corrected** — Corrects a native buffer over-read in FromCString. ([#5429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5429))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Borrowed front-buffered streams are released without disposal** — Disposing SKFrontBufferedManagedStream clears its reference to the wrapped stream even when disposeUnderlyingStream is false. The caller still owns disposal of the borrowed stream. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))
- **Fewer image-copy temporaries** — Valid managed image pixel copies avoid intermediate SKData allocation while preserving native validation for invalid inputs. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052))
- **Fewer HarfBuzz text temporaries** — HarfBuzzSharp pools UTF-32 encoding buffers and uses bounded stack storage for feature strings while preserving decoding behavior. ([#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))

## Platform

- **Windows library dependency baseline refreshed** — WinUI/MAUI library inputs align with Windows App SDK 1.7.250909003. The separately bundled WinUI ANGLE advances to chromium/8118; declared Windows runtime minimums are unchanged. ([#5390](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5390), [#5321](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5321))
